To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
four sterane hydrocararbon analogs have been prepared in moderate to good overall yields.
four sterane hydrocararbon compounds were prepared from estrone methyl and trans-androsterones by six-, four-, four-, and six-step synthetic sequences, respectively.
four new sterane derivatives were prepared in good yields from trans-androstrerone.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of 17β-methylestrane and A-nor- androstane derivatives, and the comparison of their mass spectra with the spectra of fossil organic biomarkers.
the preparation of sterane hydrocarbones with modified carbon skeletons.
the synthesis of 17β-methylandrostanes and A-nor-androstanes from readily available trans-androsterones.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the synthesis of 17β-methylandrostene and its 2α-epimer is not a simple matter, but that it is feasible.
all the four sterane hydrocarbones have been successfully synthesized.
the synthesis of the 2α-methylandrostan-17-one (3) is a very difficult task, which requires a lot of time and patience.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have prepared four androstane hydrocarbons with modified carbon skeletons.
a 5α-androstane skeleton can be modified at positions C2 and C17 in a straightforward way.
the A-ring can be reduced by the Birch reaction, and that A-ring ketones can be converted into A-nor-5-carboxylic acid derivatives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Birch reduction is a useful method for preparing steranes with a modified A-ring.
the A-ring can be modified in the sterane series without loss of the characteristic steroidal skeleton.

a number of modifications of the carbon skeleton of steroidal biomarkers can be achieved by a variety of functional group interconversions, which can be carried out with a high degree of stereoselectivity and in high overall yield.
